bio: This inn dating back to 1482 is extremely cosy and serves delicious food. The appealing à la carte selection whets the appetite with traditional home-style dishes such as Wiener schnitzel, cordon bleu and game ragout, as well as classic gourmet dishes such as medium rare venison loin, red cabbage, brioche dumplings and Brussels sprouts. In charge of this culinary offering is chef duo Marco Gatterer and Mario Naschenweng. Rustic-style tables without tablecloths; wooden benches and floorboards, as well as decorative details such as vintage pendant lamps and lots of small pictures framed on the walls make for a charming atmosphere. Attentive service....
